name: Winline
verdict: Russian bookmaker owned by five private individuals through LLC UK NKS; the largest share (45%) belongs to Andrey Myslivtsev. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: stavka.tv lists the five private founders and their shares of the legal entity LLC "Upravlyayushchaya kompaniya NKS"; no state stake and no human-rights finding found. Title partner of FC Krasnodar since 2020, with the agreement running to the end of the 2026/27 season (sports.ru, 10 Jul 2025); also a Zenit partner.
